mainEntity.name: What's the difference between web design and web development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Web design is the visual and experiential layer — layout, typography, hierarchy, UX flow, conversion logic. Web development is the technical build that brings it to life in Webflow with clean code, CMS structure, and performance optimisation. I cover both end-to-end, so the handoff friction that usually kills projects simply doesn't exist.

mainEntity.name: Do you design from scratch, or work with existing brand guidelines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. If you have an established brand system, I extend it to the web without breaking its logic — respecting your typography, colour palette, and tone. If you don't, I can design the visual identity first or collaborate with your existing designer. Either way, the final site feels coherent, not stitched together.

mainEntity.name: Will the design work on mobile and be accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — mobile-first and WCAG-aware by default, not as an afterthought. Every layout is designed for touch before desktop, with proper tap targets, readable contrast, semantic structure, and keyboard navigation. Your site looks sharp on an iPhone user's screen and remains usable for visitors relying on assistive tech.
